view_frame: The drawing presents three views of a bracket. The primary view (top-left) is the Front view, showing the X (width) and Z (height) axes. The view below it (bottom-left) is the Top view, showing X (width) and Y (depth) axes. The view to the right (bottom-right) is the Right view, showing Y (depth) and Z (height) axes.

features.placement: Extrude the profile defined in the Top view along the Z-axis. The profile consists of a vertical back edge (left), a horizontal bottom edge, a vertical front edge (right), and a chamfered top-front corner.
features.evidence: The bottom-left view shows the footprint of the part. The outline is a rectangle with the top-right corner chamfered.

features.placement: Two circular cuts located in the Front view. One is positioned near the top-right (X_max, Z_max), and the other near the bottom-right (X_max, Z_min). They pass through the full thickness of the bracket.
features.evidence: Two circles are visible in the Front view (top-left). The Right view (bottom-right) shows corresponding vertical lines indicating through-holes.

features.placement: A rectangular cut located centrally in the Front view, positioned between the two mounting holes.
features.evidence: A rectangle is visible in the center of the Front view (top-left). The Right view (bottom-right) shows vertical lines corresponding to this slot.

connections: The mounting holes and sensor slot are subtractive features applied to the bracket_body.
edit_rules: Changing the bracket thickness (Z) updates the extrusion depth of the body and the depth of the cuts.
Changing the X or Y dimensions of the body updates the profile in the Top view.
Changing the position of the holes or slot updates their coordinates in the Front view.
